parole.testo: Uncertain. A connection to Romani chullí, possibly influenced by pé (“foot”), has been proposed.

parole.significato: to make fun of, to laugh at, to mock
parole.testo: Possibly a Romani borrowing, from mangar (“to ask, beg”) (compare Hindi माँगना (māṅgnā, “to ask, request”)). In sense 3, from mango (“handle”) + -ar.

parole.significato: Romani (of or relating to the Roma people)
parole.testo: Borrowed from Romani rrom, from Sanskrit डोम (ḍoma, “member of a low caste of travelling musicians and dancers”) or डोम्ब (ḍomba).
